scope: Public feature concepts only; no implementation or test-suite files opened, no documentation examples copied
publicConcepts: Named metavariables bind syntax and repeated names constrain equality
An ellipsis can represent variable-length sequences in a syntactic scope

nativePolicy.format: Original pattern.tree objects with kind, exact text, capture, ordered named children and exact grammar fields; separate from legacy substring predicates
nativePolicy.languages: Twelve bundled grammar-backed modes; applicable CMake tree rules explicitly refuse incomplete analysis
nativePolicy.capture: One subtree or explicit grammar-field token per capture; exact structural and leaf-text equality ignoring comments/formatting; scope is one candidate and rule; no message substitution or source output
nativePolicy.sequence: At most one standalone rest:true child per list; anchored prefix/suffix, zero or more named nodes, no backtracking or crossing tree boundaries
nativePolicy.configurationLimits: 512 nodes/32 levels/128 child-list entries per rule; 4096 UTF-16 units per string; shared 10000 nodes/65536 string bytes
nativePolicy.executionLimits: Shared five-million-unit budget per source file for candidates, child/field inventories, capture traversal and UTF-8 metadata bytes hashed, plus existing parser/traversal/input/finding budgets; refusal cannot become complete baseline evidence
nativePolicy.compatibility: Legacy predicates and default methods unchanged; enabled tree rules record named-tree-patterns-v1 and require reviewed baseline migration
nativePolicy.remaining: No Semgrep syntax/CLI compatibility, exhaustive cases, typed/list captures, constant/type/import equivalences, dataflow, taint, Boolean combinations or autofix parity
nativePolicy.fields: Exact grammar-field constraints, including unnamed operator tokens; missing fields fail, captures share the child-list scope; max32 fields/node and 64 ASCII name characters/field
